title: Label changes rerun only the PR gates, not the full CI job
acceptance: Adding or removing a label (ready-to-merge, needs-owner, owner-approved) re-evaluates the owner gate without re-running install, tests, build and the e2e smoke, and the required `owner-gate` commit status reflects the gate result for the current head.
A label-only rerun can no longer turn a green PR red through a flaky e2e or cancel an in-flight run.
A label edit on an already-merged PR can no longer cancel the post-merge push run on main (a closed PR's pull_request run shares the ci-refs/heads/main concurrency group today).

The required CI check fails only on real checks, never on the owner gate: the owner gate is the `owner-gate` commit status (latest-wins), written only by owner-gate.yml on every PR event (ci.yml writes none), success for non-gated PRs and fail-closed on errors; owner-gate.yml creates no run of the required check. (Corrected 2026-11-02 for RF-176 #702; original wording: "The required CI check fails only on real checks, never on the owner gate: the owner gate is the `owner-gate` commit status (latest-wins), written by ci.yml on every PR run and by owner-gate.yml on label changes, success for non-gated PRs and fail-closed on errors; owner-gate.yml creates no run of the required check.")

evidence.summary: Final review of #643 (finding 9): every label change reruns the whole ~5 minute job because the gate shares the required job; deferred by the owner on 2026-10-27.

Owner (Steven) set RF-100 to Ready in a live Claude Code session on 2026-10-28, after label-triggered reruns of the full job on unchanged heads made #650's 'pending' check misleading three times (runs at 20:28, 20:33 and 20:41 UTC on 9589b61 for one push and two label edits).

Post-merge push runs on main for 9166826 (#649) and 492e181 (#650) were cancelled ('a higher priority waiting request for ci-refs/heads/main exists') by pull_request unlabeled runs started 4 s later when ready-to-merge was removed from the merged PR. Until fixed, remove ready-to-merge before merging, not after.

PR #700: label events run only owner-gate.yml (same required check name; waits for this head's full ci.yml marker step, then re-runs the owner gate with live labels); ci.yml drops labeled/unlabeled and keys concurrency per PR. ci.yml run 41389896266 on 2655052 passed every step except the owner gate; removing and re-adding needs-owner started two Owner gate runs (41390366895, 41390368848, ~12 s each, no install/test/build/e2e, no new CI run) that judged the full run and failed only on the owner gate, as designed.

Live approval test on 22421a7 failed: owner-gate.yml run 41434803378 passed in 15 s and recorded owner-approval, but the PR stayed BLOCKED. The ruleset and statusCheckRollup read the required check across every check suite, and ci.yml run 41402534763 still held a failed run under the required name (its owner gate step), so a newer success in another suite cannot replace it. Owner chose option 1: the owner gate becomes the latest-wins `owner-gate` commit status and the required CI job never fails on it.

Status design on f21f8fa: CI run 41440215069 passed the required check and its owner gate status job (it voided the stale owner-approved label, since f21f8fa has no approval) and wrote owner-gate = failure ('Owner-gated paths need owner-approved on f21f8fa'). Adding then removing ready-to-merge started Owner gate runs 41440901095 and 41441024681 (~18 s, record job skipped, no CI run) that each rewrote owner-gate = failure. Rollup: required check SUCCESS, owner-gate FAILURE, mergeStateStatus UNSTABLE (BLOCKED once the ruleset requires owner-gate).

Correction (2026-11-02): #700's body called the void race 'fixed', and the f21f8fa evidence above reads as if voiding were safe. It was not: void-approval could still remove an owner-approved label applied seconds after a push, before record-approval wrote owner-approval on the new head. #700 merged under a one-time owner waiver with that and four other fail-closed issues listed in the squash message; RF-176 fixes them.

Owner approved closing RF-100 and RF-176 ("Yes to both") in the Air session on 2026-11-02, recorded on #706. Gate observed on #705 (https://github.com/steven-crosby/ritmofit-web/pull/705): owner-gate stayed failure until owner-approved was recorded on 8a4078a, and the PR was BLOCKED only on owner-gate while the required CI check was green.
Acceptance item 4 restated in full after the #708 review, keeping the original wording.

resolution: Label events run only owner-gate.yml, which writes the required `owner-gate` commit status; ci.yml writes no status and keys concurrency per PR, so a label edit no longer reruns or cancels CI and the required CI check fails only on real checks. The fail-closed issues #700 merged with under a one-time waiver were fixed in RF-176; remaining edge cases are in RF-175.
